ApplicableRules.name: Applicable Rules
ApplicableRules.definition: Specifies the rules that are applicable to the drawdown. For example, in the UK market, the pre-A-day rule that was introduced on 6 April 2006.)

InvestorTaxReference.name: Investor Tax Reference
InvestorTaxReference.definition: Identification of the investor as assigned by a tax authority.

PercentageOfTotalTransferValue.name: Percentage Of Total Transfer Value
PercentageOfTotalTransferValue.definition: Percentage of the total transfer value covered by the drawdown.

TotalAmountNetDrawdown.name: Total Amount Net Drawdown
TotalAmountNetDrawdown.definition: Amount that was originally designated for drawdown.

AdditionalFundsDesignated.name: Additional Funds Designated
AdditionalFundsDesignated.definition: Indicates whether any additional funds have been designated since the original arrangement.

PensionCommencementLumpSumRemaining.name: Pension Commencement Lump Sum Remaining
PensionCommencementLumpSumRemaining.definition: Amount of the pension commencement lump sum (PCLS) remaining.

PensionCommencementLumpSumDate.name: Pension Commencement Lump Sum Date
PensionCommencementLumpSumDate.definition: Date by which the pension commencement lump sum (PCLS) must be used.

MultiplePensionCommencementLumpSums.name: Multiple Pension Commencement Lump Sums
MultiplePensionCommencementLumpSums.definition: Indicates there have been multiple pension commencement lump sum (PCLS) payments.

LifetimeAllowance.name: Lifetime Allowance
LifetimeAllowance.definition: Percentage of the lifetime allowance (LTA) used.

RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator.name: Recipient Of Drawdown Indicator
RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator.definition: Indicates a person other than the original pension holder is the receiver of the drawdown payment.

BeneficiaryDetails.name: Beneficiary Details
BeneficiaryDetails.definition: Information about the recipient of the drawdown, when not the original pension holder.

FlexibleDrawdownTriggeredDate.name: Flexible Drawdown Triggered Date
FlexibleDrawdownTriggeredDate.definition: Date on which the drawdown was triggered when the drawdown type is flexible.

TrancheDate.name: Tranche Date
TrancheDate.definition: Date on which the tranche is actioned

BeneficiaryDetailsRule.definition: If RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then BeneficiaryDetails is not allowed.|If RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then BeneficiaryDetails may be present.
